usage: nb-collab append [-h] [--markdown TEXT] [--code TEXT]
                        [--markdown-file PATH] [--code-file PATH]
                        [--summary TEXT] [--eta DURATION] [--execute | --wait]
                        [--follow] [--server-url SERVER_URL] [--token TOKEN]
                        [--settle SETTLE] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--poll POLL]
                        notebook

Appends markdown and/or code cells at the end of a JupyterLab-open notebook
via the YDoc/RTC channel. Inserted cells are tagged metadata.hera (a dict
carrying the version tag and an appended_at UTC timestamp) so they can be
filtered and timed later. Re-running with the same args double-inserts.

positional arguments:
  notebook              Path to .ipynb (absolute or relative to cwd).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --markdown TEXT       Append a markdown cell with this source. Pass '-' to
                        read the cell from stdin; multiple '-' flags consume
                        successive chunks separated by a line of '---|'.
                        Repeatable; order preserved across all
                        --markdown/--code variants.
  --code TEXT           Append an un-executed code cell with this source. Pass
                        '-' to read the cell from stdin (see --markdown for
                        chunk semantics). Repeatable; order preserved across
                        all --markdown/--code variants.
  --markdown-file PATH  Append a markdown cell whose source is read from PATH
                        (UTF-8). Repeatable; order-preserved.
  --code-file PATH      Append an un-executed code cell whose source is read
                        from PATH (UTF-8). Repeatable; order-preserved.
  --summary TEXT        One-line dense spec of the proposed measurement.
                        Rendered into the FIRST appended markdown cell, right
                        after its leading heading (or prepended if the cell
                        has none) as a timestamped blockquote: '> **14:32** ·
                        <summary>' — the clock is server-local time at append;
                        _/* in the text are escaped for rendering. Also
                        stamped verbatim to metadata.hera.summary on that
                        cell. Requires at least one markdown cell among the
                        appended cells (--markdown/--markdown-file); must not
                        contain a backtick. At most once.
  --eta DURATION        Expected runtime for the proposed measurement — '40m',
                        '2h', or '1h30m' (optional <N>h then optional <N>m, h
                        before m; at least one required, total > 0; fractional
                        values rejected). A bare number like '40' is REJECTED
                        — add the m/h suffix. Rendered into the FIRST appended
                        markdown cell's blockquote line (with --summary or
                        alone) as '**ETA ~15:12** (≈40 min)' in server-local
                        time, computed from the same append instant; crossing
                        local midnight adds ' (+1d)' right after the clock.
                        Also stamped as an ISO-8601 UTC instant to
                        metadata.hera.eta_at on that cell, and echoed to
                        stdout as 'eta: ~15:12 (≈40 min)'. Requires at least
                        one markdown cell among the appended cells. At most
                        once.
  --execute             After appending, run the last appended code cell
                        YOURSELF by the id this append just created (never
                        nb['cells'][-1] off the stale on-disk file). Policy-
                        gated like execute-cell (append_exec or edit_exec),
                        checked before any cell lands. Exit code reflects the
                        cell's status. Mutually exclusive with --wait.
=====
usage: hera-watch [-h] [--next] [--once] [--poll POLL] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                  [--follow] [--wait-start WAIT_START] [--channels CHANNELS]
                  [--raw] [--bias-current BIAS_CURRENT] [--every EVERY]
                  [--fs-warn FS_WARN] [--leak-excess-warn LEAK_EXCESS_WARN]
                  run_dir

Live run-dir digest: one line per landed sweep row (gain-divided Rxx/I stats +
progress/ETA) for an agent to tail.

positional arguments:
  run_dir               sweep run directory (contains metadata.json +
                        data.tsv). May not exist yet — the watch waits up to
                        --wait-start for it to appear. With --next, give a
                        data/ dir instead.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --next                treat run_dir as a data/ dir and latch onto the NEXT
                        run to appear (arm before the cell runs). Robust to
                        2nd+ runs and lowest-free-id allocation — snapshots
                        existing runs, waits for a new one.
  --once                digest current state then exit (no watch loop)
  --poll POLL           poll interval in seconds while watching (default 5)
  --timeout TIMEOUT     stop the measurement watch after this many seconds
                        (default 570, sub-CC-Bash-cap). See --follow.
  --follow              watch to completion with no deadline (multi-hour
                        runs); overrides --timeout. Use with a backgrounded
                        invocation.
  --wait-start WAIT_START
                        if run_dir doesn't exist yet, wait up to this many
                        seconds for it to appear (default 1800; <=0 waits
                        indefinitely)
  --channels CHANNELS   comma-separated lock-in channels to include (e.g.
                        sr1,sr2). Default: all.
  --raw                 report raw lock-in X (skip gain division). Escape
                        hatch.
  --bias-current BIAS_CURRENT
                        override I_bias in amps (default:
                        bias_voltage/bias_resistor from metadata)
  --every EVERY         1D sweeps: emit a digest line every N new rows
                        (default 25)
  --fs-warn FS_WARN     warn when a lock-in's max|X| reaches this fraction of
                        its full-scale sensitivity (default 0.90; SR830 rails
                        ~1.09×). Requires sensitivity in the instrument
                        snapshot.
  --leak-excess-warn LEAK_EXCESS_WARN
                        warn when a gate current's excess over its baseline
                        (max|I - I0|) reaches this many amps on 2+ consecutive
                        points (default 100e-12 = 100 pA)

# vti-02 stacking-order plan (written 2026-08-23 at handoff pickup; steps 1–3 were run by the previous instance)

Goal: ABAB vs ABCA vs ABCB, region-resolved (one pair wired: sr1 = B_1−B_2), evidence-cited. No Rxy channel —
every filling-factor read comes from Rxx minima lines in the (n, B) plane.

## Discriminants (what the data must show)
- **ABCA (rhombohedral)**: one chiral band, zero-energy LL 16-fold (4 orbitals × spin/valley). Fan at D = 0: gap-free
  block |ν| < 8 at low B, first strong minima at ν = ±8, then Δν = 4; symmetry-broken integers appear only at high B.
  SdH at fixed n: a single fundamental at F_L = n h/4e (plus harmonics). B = 0 CNP at D = 0 gapless / weakly gapped.
- **ABAB (Bernal)**: two bilayer-like sub-bands (light + heavy) overlapping at D = 0 (semimetal). Fan: two
  interpenetrating LL ladders with different slopes, LL crossings; near the CNP electron- and hole-like lines coexist.
  SdH at fixed n: two fundamentals F_light + F_heavy = F_L (light ≈ 0.2–0.3 F_L).
- **ABCB (mixed)**: monolayer-like Dirac band + bilayer-like band, no inversion → intrinsic gap at D = 0. Fan: a
  Dirac-like sequence (ν = ±2, ±6, ±10 …) superimposed on a 4-fold ladder; CNP gapped at D = 0 already at B = 0.
- Confound carried since runs 0–3: **series mosaic** — a second CNP ridge (region B) electron-doped by 0.43×10¹² vs
  region A (run 5). Its fan is region A's fan shifted by Δn = +0.43×10¹² along n (same slopes). Read both.

## Steps
1. ✅ Gate C liveness (runs 0–3): alive, 60–330 Ω, no leakage. Two CNPs in series.
2. ✅ 0 T gatemap (run 5; run 4 railed): CNP ridge A, ratio c_bg/c_tg = 0.773, n_offset −0.089, D_offset −0.013
   (R_CNP(D) vertex). Absolute n scale = geometry prior (c_tg at 9.5 nm) — **uncalibrated until the fan slopes fix it**.
3. ✅ SdH spot checks at D = 0 (run 6: n = +3.2; run 7: n = −1.2): oscillations from ~1.6 T, Rxx → 0 minima on the
   electron side; irregular 1/B spacing on both — two ladders and/or the mosaic; 1D cannot separate them.
4. **▶ Landau fan at D = 0** (`landau-fan`): B slow 1.5 → 10 T (0.1 T, 86 rows), (V_tg, V_bg) co-swept along the
   calibrated D = 0 line, n = −1.25 … +3.25×10¹² (129 pts). Establishes: the ν sequence at low ν (high B), LL crossings
   (Bernal) or their absence, the absolute n scale from the line slopes (dn/dB = ν e/h), and the region-B offset fan.
   ~5.5 h. Ends at 10 T.
5. Depending on step 4: (a) if lines are clean, a D ≠ 0 fan or a fixed-B (10 T) (n, D) map to test gap opening vs D
   (ABCA: ν = 0 gap grows monotonically with |D|; ABAB: LL crossings move with D); (b) if T_e-limited, a short
   temperature ladder on one strong minimum for the LL gap / mass. Ride the magnet down through whatever comes next.
6. Call in ana (output contract), then `return-to-initial` on the operator's ask.

## What would change my mind
- Fan lines not straight through the origin → n calibration/offset wrong → refit before any ν assignment.
- Region B dominating (its fan stronger than A's) → the contact pair reads mostly region B; call per region anyway.
- Rail of sr1 across a broad low-|n| band at high B → the ν = 0 state is ≥ 20 kΩ: strongly gapped — itself evidence.
- No minima below ν ≈ 8 at 10 T on either side → consistent with ABCA's 16-fold zero LL; ν = ±4 minima present at
  moderate B → against ABCA.

## Runs 6–7 — `sdh-spot-check` at D = 0: n = +3.2×10¹² (run 6, B 0 → 10 T) and n = −1.2×10¹² (run 7, 10 → 0.3 T)

Raw |Rxx|(B), Rxx(1/B) with the minima marked (labels = ν from the run-5 density, whose absolute scale is still the geometry prior), and the SdH FFT in 1/B over 2–10 T (cubic B-space background), against F_L = n h/4e for a single 4-fold Fermi surface. **Read — run 6 (electron):** oscillations from ≈ 1.6 T and Rxx → 0 (≤ 4 Ω) minima already at 1.85 T — well-formed Landau levels, high mobility; zeros at 1.85, 1.99, 2.45, 2.71, 3.24, 3.72, 4.30, 5.91, 6.08, 7.15 T. Above 7.5 T Rxx climbs to ≈ 500 Ω (structured plateau 8.4–9.0 T, ν_cal ≈ 15) and drops toward 10 T (ν_cal 13.2). The minima are **not** periodic in 1/B — paired zeros (1.85/1.99, 2.31/2.45, 5.91/6.08) say more than one Landau ladder is present. FFT: 7.5 T dominant with 15 / 22.5 / 30 T — a comb consistent with harmonics of 7.5 T, but `sdh_onset` also tracks 31.3 T independently; F_L(cal) = 33.1 T. Two readings fit equally in 1D: (i) two sub-bands F_light ≈ 7.5 + F_heavy ≈ 30 T (Bernal-like pair; their sum 37.5 T vs F_L 33.1 T would mean the density scale is ~12 % low), or (ii) one ladder whose Rxx → 0 zeros generate the harmonic comb. **Run 7 (hole):** oscillations from ≈ 1.6 T; minima at 1.68, 2.04 (→ 0), 2.74, 3.38, 4.14, 4.92, 6.00, 6.96, 8.36 T with the 1/B spacing shrinking from 0.105 to 0.024 T⁻¹ toward high B — the ν step between successive minima falls (4 → 2 → 1-like), i.e. symmetry-broken integer states emerging at high B and/or interleaving with region B's ladder (there n_B ≈ −0.77×10¹²); R rises monotonically above 8.4 T to 590 Ω at 10 T (ν_cal = 5, entering the low-ν regime). FFT: 5.0 and 12.5 T (F_L(cal) = 12.4 T). **Take:** T_e permits SdH from 1.5 T; Rxx maxima ≤ 590 Ω at |n| ≥ 1.2×10¹² (sizes the fan sensitivity); the ladder/mosaic ambiguity is a 2D question — the Landau fan (plan step 4) separates region-B lines (parallel, offset in n) from a second sub-band (different slope) and fixes the absolute n scale from the line slopes.

"""sdh-spot-check read, runs 6 (n = +3.2e12) and 7 (n = -1.2e12), D = 0 (run-5 cal): raw R(B), R(1/B) + minima, onset, FFT vs F_L."""
import warnings
from scipy.signal import find_peaks, savgol_filter
warnings.simplefilter("ignore")

RUNS = {6: +3.2e12, 7: -1.2e12}     # cm^-2 (run-5 cal, region A; absolute scale = geometry prior)
FS = 50e-6 / 10e-9                  # sr1 50 uV at 10 nA -> 5 kOhm full scale
fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(14, 11))
for k, (rid, n_cm2) in enumerate(RUNS.items()):
    r = run(rid)
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); I = r.col("sr0_X") / r.meta["measurement_config"]["sr0_gain"]
    R = np.abs(r.col("sr1_X") / 1.0 / I); Tm = r.col("T_sample")
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R, I, Tm = B[o], R[o], I[o], Tm[o]
    n_si = abs(n_cm2) * 1e4; F_L = float(luttinger_frequency(n_si))
    print(f"=== run {rid}: n = {n_cm2/1e12:+.1f}e12 -> F_L = {F_L:.1f} T; I_bias {np.median(I)*1e9:.2f} nA; |R| {R.min():.1f}-{R.max():.0f} Ohm; "
          f"T_sample {Tm.min():.3f}-{Tm.max():.3f} K; nu(10 T) = {n_si*cst.h/(cst.e*10):.1f}")
    sel = B > 1.5; Rs_ = savgol_filter(R[sel], 7, 2); Bs_ = B[sel]
    mins, _ = find_peaks(-Rs_, prominence=8); maxs, _ = find_peaks(Rs_, prominence=8)
    nu_min = n_si * cst.h / (cst.e * Bs_[mins])
    print("  minima B/R/nu_cal: " + ", ".join(f"{b:.2f}/{rr:.0f}/{v:.1f}" for b, rr, v in zip(Bs_[mins], Rs_[mins], nu_min)))
    print("  1/B spacing of minima (1/T): " + ", ".join(f"{d:.3f}" for d in -np.diff(1 / Bs_[mins])))
    try:
        on = sdh_onset(R, B, b_lo=0.5, r_full_scale=FS); print(on.summary())
    except Exception as e:
        print("  sdh_onset:", type(e).__name__, e)
    f, sp = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(2.0, B.max()), nfft=2048, bg_degree=3, log=False); sp = sp[0]
    m = f > 2; pk, _ = find_peaks(sp[m], prominence=0.1 * sp[m].max())
    print(f"  FFT (2-10 T, dF {1/(1/2.0-1/B.max()):.1f} T) peaks: " + ", ".join(f"{ff:.1f} T" for _, ff in sorted(zip(sp[m][pk], f[m][pk]), reverse=True)[:5]))

    ax = axes[0, k]; ax.plot(B, R, lw=0.8); ax.plot(Bs_[mins], Rs_[mins], "rv", ms=4); ax.plot(Bs_[maxs], Rs_[maxs], "g^", ms=4)
    ax.set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("|Rxx| (Ohm)"); ax.set_title(f"run {rid}: n = {n_cm2/1e12:+.1f}e12, D = 0 — raw |Rxx|(B), sr1 50 uV (FS {FS:.0f} Ohm)")

Plan step 4 (`hera_scratch/plan.md`) — the stacking measurement the operator asked for. The 1D spot checks (runs 6–7, ana) show well-formed Landau levels from ≈ 1.6 T (Rxx → 0 zeros at 1.85 T on the electron side) but minima that are not periodic in 1/B: either two sub-bands (a Bernal-like light/heavy pair) or the series-mosaic region B (Δn = +0.43×10¹²) interleaving its ladder — undecidable in 1D. In the (n, B) plane those separate: Rxx minima run along lines of constant ν = n h/eB through the origin; a second region gives the **same** slopes offset along n, a second sub-band gives **different** slopes and LL crossings. The low-ν sequence at high B (ν = ±4, ±8, ±12 …) reads the zero-LL degeneracy (16-fold for ABCA, two crossing ladders for ABAB, a Dirac-like ±2, ±6 sequence for ABCB), and the line slopes fix the absolute density scale that run 5 left at the geometry prior. **Design:** field is the expensive axis (0.137 T/min) → B slow, 1.5 → 10 T in 0.1 T (86 rows), starting where the magnet sits (0 T after the handoff; the 1.5 T lead-in is 11 min) and ending at 10 T; fast axis = (V_tg, V_bg) co-swept along the run-5 D = 0 line (D_offset −0.013 V/nm), n = −1.25 … +3.25×10¹² in 129 points (0.035×10¹² per point, ≈ 10 mV TG steps) — at 2 T a Δν = 4 line spacing is 0.19×10¹² ≈ 5–6 points, at 10 T 0.97×10¹² ≈ 28 points. **Coverage trade:** the hole side stops at n = −1.25×10¹² (TG −0.3 V limit) → ν ≥ −5 at 10 T only; the electron side reaches ν = +13 at 10 T, +52 at 2.5 T. D ≠ 0 is not covered here (step 5 candidate). `fast_delay` 1.0 s (τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB → ≈ 1-point lag, as in the run-5 map), `slow_delay` 3 s after each flyback. **Sensitivity** sr1 200 µV = 20 kΩ FS: runs 6–7 maxima ≤ 590 Ω at |n| ≥ 1.2×10¹²; the ν = 0 column at high B may exceed 20 kΩ and soft-clip — that reads as "≥ 20 kΩ, insulating", itself evidence — while metallic minima keep ≈ 0.75 Ω resolution. Leak guard 1 nA on both Keithleys (baselines −100 / +25 pA). **Price** (run-5 rate 1.17 s/pt → 1.2 s/pt with two gates): 86 × (129 × 1.2 s + 44 s ramp + 3 s settle + 3 s slow_delay + 2 s flyback) ≈ 4.95 h + 11 min lead-in ≈ 5.2 h; realistic 5 h 30 m.
